title: Affine K-injective cohomology comparison
statement: For an affine morphism f and a K-injective complex I with quasi-coherent cohomology, the homology of module direct image is isomorphic to the direct image of homology in every degree.

proof.text: Use scalar restriction T from f_*O_X to O_Y. Its composite with the underlying sheaf functor is definitionally unchanged; Mathlib reflection and preservation lemmas make T exact and conservative. The source-library exact-functor derived-composition isomorphism identifies Rg_* followed by RT with Rf_*; all comparisons are natural.

Apply affine higher-direct-image vanishing to quasi-coherent modules. Convert positive integer degrees to natural degrees and use bounded-below/unbounded single-object compatibility to obtain the hacyc hypothesis of the natural unbounded scheme-pushforward comparison.

For E=Q(I), homologyFunctorFactors transports hI to quasi-coherent derived cohomology. Lower truncation E prime at n also has quasi-coherent cohomology, by the source-library homologyProperty_truncGE theorem. The natural comparison from lem-sc-qcoh-acyclic-derived-pushforward-cohomology sends the lower-truncation projection to ordinary pushforward of its degree-n homology isomorphism. Hence its derived scheme pushforward is invertible on degree-n homology. Transport through the natural scalar-restriction comparison and use conservativity of T to prove that H^n(Rg_*(E -> E prime)) is invertible over f_*O_X.

Module direct image is left exact: underlying module presheaves are precomposed with the inverse-image-open functor, which preserves limits. Supply enough injectives from lem-sc-ringed-space-module-sheaves-enough-injectives and apply the general left-exact bottom-cohomology comparison to E prime. Compose with the truncation isomorphism to obtain H^n(Rg_*E) isomorphic to g_*H^n(E).

The identity quasi-isomorphism on the K-injective I computes Rg_*(Q(I)) as Q(g_*I), by derivedModuleDirectImage_computed_by_resolution. Apply homology and compose the two homologyFunctorFactors isomorphisms with the preceding comparison. Pair the resulting algebra-module isomorphism with True.intro.

proof_origin.place: P3 second reading: exact conservative scalar restriction, natural affine comparison, lower truncation and left-exact bottom cohomology; uses the existing Stacks 0AVW/08D4 route.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_algebra_kinjective_cohomology_comparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] (hI : ∀ n : ℤ, (I.homology n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
          (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I).homology n ≅
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj (I.homology n), True
